title: A continuous section of the geometric-fiber component map
statement: Let X be a nonempty irreducible affine scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-irreducible-components], Ω a field, and η:Spec Ω→X map its point to the generic point. Let U→X be an affine pro-etale object [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] whose global ring is w-contractible [sk-def-pe-wlocal]. Put V=U×_X Spec Ω and let r:π₀(V)→π₀(U) be induced by the first projection, with the profinite quotient topologies [lem-pe-spectral-components-profinite]. There is a continuous s:π₀(U)→π₀(V) satisfying r∘s=id. Neither algebraic closedness of Ω nor a separate ind-etale hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Proof of Theorem 4.13, diagram (4.4) and the following coefficient paragraph

proof.text: The pro-etale structure map f is flat. Represent a component c by x∈U. Mathlib Flat.generalizingMap lifts the specialization from the generic point of X to f(x), giving y specializing to x and mapping to the generic point. The two points have equal component classes. Choose the field point z of Spec Ω. Since f(y)=η(z), Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback gives v over y and z. The class of v maps to c, proving surjectivity, also for empty U.

proof.text: Identify U with Spec Γ(U,⊤) by its affine isoSpec, then use the induced connected-components homeomorphism. W-contractibility makes the component quotient of this spectrum extremally disconnected; transport this property to π₀(U).

source.place: Proof of Theorem 4.13, diagram (4.4) and the following coefficient paragraph

proof.text: The two component spaces are compact Hausdorff. Mathlib CompactT2.ExtremallyDisconnected.projective lifts the identity of π₀(U) through the continuous surjection r. The equality of continuous maps gives Function.LeftInverse r s pointwise.

lean.statement: theorem generic_fiber_component_section (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] [Nonempty X] [IrreducibleSpace X] (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] (η : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) (hη : ∀ x, η x = genericPoint X) (U : X.ProEt) [IsAffine U.left] (hw : IsWContractibleRing Γ(U.left, ⊤)) : let : IsAffineHom (show U.left ⟶ X from U.hom) := isAffineHom_of_isAffine (show U.left ⟶ X from U.hom) let : IsAffineHom η := isAffineHom_of_isAffine η let : IsAffine (pullback U.hom η) := instIsAffinePullbackSchemeOfIsAffineHom_1 (show U.left ⟶ X from U.hom) η let S := componentProfinite U.left let Sη := componentProfinite (pullback U.hom η) let r : C(Sη, S) := ⟨(pullback.fst U.hom η).continuous.connectedComponentsMap, (pullback.fst U.hom η).continuous.connectedComponentsMap_continuous⟩ ∃ s : C(S, Sη), Function.LeftInverse r s
